integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard nuclear-norm duality and factorization. Finite-field checker tests two examples, not the general quantifier. No independent audit or priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Complex Schur norm and rank-one trace-class normers only. Every abstract finite projective plane of order q>=2, without asserting existence for every q. Full high-rank equality is not classified. The Schur norm formula is known via general trace-norm reduction; novelty is uniqueness of probability weights and phase freedom of all rank-one normers.
title: Rigidity of Schur-multiplier norming weights for projective-plane incidence masks
